normalization: cuobjdump instruction bodies; collapse whitespace only; retain offsets/encodings/attributes

semantics.preserved: All native sources/PE/82 bodies/resources/layout, PF runtime/config, CDF search/clamp/uniform weights/streams/scratch/fallback, model/count/RNG/tolerance retained.

build_configuration: CUDA 12.8 / MSVC Release / compute 7.5 / C++20 / no fast math
